title: 第20章 执念劫中照本心第21章 魔罗睺心魔收割者
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、执念裂隙·心魔幻境
大胤三百一十二年，霜降戌时，中天棋盘「执念劫」位浮现血色秤杆，秤砣上刻着「心魔幻境」四字。
忘忧谷的竹亭突然扭曲成镜像迷宫，每个竹节中都封印着众人最隐秘的执念：
-沈墨卿的执念：
惊鸿剑化作断刃，剑鞘中藏着未送出的「止战书」，书皮上是太昊氏祭司的血手印。
-萧素雪的执念：
测天丝编织成幽冥墟的曼陀罗花，花蕊中浮现初代监秤人的骸骨倒影。
-楚轩行的执念：
「权」字笔悬在「仁」字玺上方，笔尖滴落的墨汁竟凝成云栖鹤隐的青铜蝶面。
执念劫法则：
-劫界主「转轮」以「心秤」称量众生执念，越沉重者越深陷幻境；
-执念具象化后会吞噬现实记忆，最终让人沦为「执念傀儡」；
-心秤的平衡链由「欲望」「遗憾」「贪嗔」编织而成，斩断任意一环都会引发劫界崩塌。
百里鸿生的警告：
窥天车在劫界边缘破碎，天机算化作无数「执念残卷」：「诸君所见执念，皆是劫界主刻意放大的「心锚」——但最深的执念，藏在劫界核心的「无妄海」。
二、楚轩行·执念迷局
楚轩行踏入无妄海，发现海水是凝固的「悔恨之泪」，每滴泪中都封印着他曾做出的抉择：
-选择权术而非仁心时，泪中浮现百姓的诅咒；
-选择破劫而非自保时，泪中倒映云栖鹤隐的牺牲。
转轮现身：

他手持「心秤」从海底升起，秤盘两端分别压着「楚轩行」与「监秤人」的灵魂碎片：「你可知，初代监秤人为何选择自我放逐？因为他发现——执念才是劫界的燃料。
-记忆篡改：
楚轩行脑海中浮现虚假画面：自己亲手将云栖鹤隐推入劫界裂缝，只为换取「破劫者」的名号。
道心考验：
转轮抛出「执念棋子」，楚轩行的肉身开始被「监秤人」的记忆覆盖：「承认吧，你破劫的执念，本质是对「成为救世主」的贪婪。
三、正道·现世执念战
沈墨卿的因果悖论：
他的道骨竹节浮现太昊氏咒文，惊鸿剑竟不受控制地斩向儒门弟子：「前世的「仁」是杀，今生的「仁」是救——这因果，何其荒谬！
-萧素雪的琴心渡厄：
content_en:
1. Cracks in Obsession·Illusions of Inner Demons
In the 312th year of Dayin, at the time of frost and Xu, a bloody scale beam appeared on the "Obsession Tribulation" position on the Zhongtian chessboard, and the four words "Inner Demon Fantasy" were engraved on the scale.
The bamboo pavilion in Wangyou Valley suddenly twisted into a mirror maze, and everyone's most secret obsessions were sealed in each bamboo joint:
-Shen Moqing’s obsession:
The Jinghong Sword turned into a broken blade, and the scabbard contained an unsent "End of War Book". On the cover of the book was the bloody handprint of Taihao's priest.
-Xiao Suxue’s obsession:
The mandala flower of Netherworld Ruins is woven from Tencelestial Silk, and the reflection of the skeleton of the first scale monitor appears in the stamen.
-Chu Xuanying’s obsession:
The pen with the word "Quan" hangs above the seal with the word "Ren", and the ink dripping from the tip of the pen actually condenses into the bronze butterfly surface of Yunqi Heyin.
The law of obsession:
-The Lord of Tribulation's "Wheel" uses the "Heart Scale" to weigh the obsessions of all living beings. The heavier the weight, the deeper into the illusion;
-When obsessions materialize, they will devour the memory of reality, eventually turning people into "obsession puppets";
-The balance chain of the heart scale is woven from "desire", "regret" and "greed and anger". Cutting off any link will cause the collapse of the calamity world.
Baili Hongsheng’s warning:
The sky-peeping chariot was shattered at the edge of the calamity world, and the heavenly secrets turned into countless "obsession fragments": "The obsessions you see are all the "heart anchors" deliberately amplified by the master of the calamity world - but the deepest obsession is hidden in the "Wuwang Sea" at the core of the calamity world.
2. Chu Xuanxing·Obsession and Confusion
Chu Xuanxing stepped into Wuwu Sea and found that the sea water was solidified "tears of regret", and the choices he had made were sealed in every tear:
-When you choose power over benevolence, the curse of the people appears in your tears;
-When he chose to break the catastrophe rather than protect himself, Yunqi Heyin's sacrifice was reflected in his tears.
The wheel appears:
He held the "Heart Scale" and rose from the bottom of the sea. The soul fragments of "Chu Xuanxing" and the "Scale Supervisor" were pressed on both ends of the scale: "Do you know why the first-generation Scale Supervisor chose to self-exile? Because he discovered that obsession is the fuel of the world of calamity.
-Memory tampering:
A false picture appeared in Chu Xuanying's mind: he personally pushed Yunqi Heyin into the crack of the robbery world, just in exchange for the title of "tribulation breaker".
Taoist test:
The wheel threw the "obsession chess piece", and Chu Xuanxing's body began to be covered by the memory of the "scale monitor": "Admit it, your obsession with overcoming the disaster is essentially greed for "becoming a savior."
3. Righteous Path·War of Obsession in this World
Shen Moqing’s paradox of cause and effect:
Taihao's incantation appeared on the bamboo joints of his Taoist bones, and the Jinghong Sword unexpectedly slashed at the Confucian disciples uncontrollably: "The "benevolence" in the previous life was to kill, and the "benevolence" in this life is to save - this cause and effect is so ridiculous!
